explication: Scriberr is a privacy-focused, self-hosted audio transcription application. Users upload or record audio through the web/PWA UI, or use the folder-watching CLI; the API authenticates requests and queues jobs. Background processing preprocesses audio, selects registered local transcription/diarization adapters, persists results, and streams status back to the UI. Transcripts support notes, summaries, and chat through configurable LLM providers. The graph reflects sampled wiring plus README-documented capabilities; several handler implementations were not sampled.
